item.title: 'Considerable progress' made on Mansfield train derailment cleanup, shelter in place lifted
item.description: MANSFIELD, Conn. (WTNH) — Recovery and cleanup operations continue in Mansfield after a train derailment on Thursday. At approximately 9 a.m. on Thursday, 13 cars derailed from a 43-car train traveling southbound near Route 32 in Mansfield.
